panelPlan: Wide early-morning municipal control room: Matt sits alone at his usual console in yesterday’s rumpled work jacket, shoulders heavy, coffee untouched beside blue-gray drainage monitors.
His manager arrives at the neighboring station, sets a bag down and rolls the chair toward Matt’s board while other staff begin ordinary shifts in the background.
Matt pushes one hand against the desk and half rises from his chair on “I can work,” eyes fixed on the active monitor wall.
Medium two-shot: the manager raises an open palm toward Matt and turns the other hand toward the console on “Go home anyway”; Matt’s shoulders drop before his quiet “Okay.”
